title: A Starch Phosphorylase, ZmPHOH, Improves Photosynthetic Recovery from Short-Term Cold Exposure in Maize
genotypes: PH6WC (wild type); chl3 (null mutant of ZmPHOH/starch phosphorylase 2, in PH6WC background; slow photosynthetic recovery after cold)
stage_age: seedlings grown 25 d at 28 °C in pots after 2 d germination (before five-leaf stage)
growth_system: growth chamber; soil pots; 14/10 h light/dark, 40 µmol m-2 s-1 PAR, 65% humidity; cold started 1 h after lights off
cold_treatments: 8 °C for 2 d (48 h), then returned to 28 °C
control_temperature: 28 °C (time 0 before cold; RNA-seq control = pre-cold samples)
other_factors: WT vs chl3 mutant; recovery after cold
timepoints_duration: control (pre-cold); 24 h cold (C1, physiology/metabolites only); 48 h cold (C2); 48 h after return to 28 °C (R); RNA-seq at control, C2 and R
n_libraries: 18 (computed: 2 genotypes x 3 time points x 3 reps)
accession: not found (Data Availability statement says data are included in the article)
other_omics: GC-MS soluble sugar and starch profiling; photosynthetic gas exchange; native-PAGE enzyme activity
key_finding: chl3 cannot catabolize cold-accumulated soluble sugars during recovery, repressing photosynthetic genes and delaying recovery
source_of_details: PMC full text; PMC web page (data availability statement)
notes: Reads aligned to B73 RefGen_v4 (HISAT2); DESeq2. chl3 line described in Qin et al. 2022. Only 3 RNA-seq time points per genotype (no 24 h library).

title: Maize transcriptome profiling reveals low temperatures affect photosynthesis during the emergence stage
genotypes: LT (cold-tolerant) and LS (cold-susceptible) inbred lines from Maize Research Institute Zemun Polje (parents of commercial ZP hybrids); heterotic groups Lancaster and semi-dent (assignment to lines not resolved in text)
tissue: seedlings (30 pooled per sample; plant part not specified)
growth_system: climate chamber (MLR-352H-PE); germinated 5 d in dark at 25/20 °C, 12/12 h, 75% RH; treatment under 12/12 h light/dark, 700 µmol m-2 s-1
control_temperature: 25/20 °C (day/night), same photoperiod and light, sampled at the same times
bio_reps: 1 pooled sample per condition for RNA-seq (no RNA-seq replicates); qRT-PCR 3
platform_layout: Illumina NovaSeq 6000, PE150; rRNA-depleted directional libraries (Novogene)
other_omics: lncRNA and circRNA analysis; miRNA interaction network (small RNA data details NR); qRT-PCR
key_finding: Photosynthesis genes down in both lines; tolerant line up-regulates photoprotection genes (ctpa2, grx, elip, UF3GT)
source_of_details: PMC full text; PMC web page (data availability statement)
notes: Reads mapped to B73 NAM v5 (STAR). Unreplicated RNA-seq (one library per genotype x treatment x time). Whole-transcriptome study (mRNA, lncRNA, circRNA).

title: Integrating physiological, metabolome and transcriptome revealed the response of maize seeds to combined cold and high soil moisture stresses
genotypes: Jidan441 (JD441; resistant to combined cold and high moisture stress, CHS); Jidan558 (JD558; CHS-sensitive)
tissue: seeds/germinating seeds (tissue sampled for transcriptome NR)
stage_age: treatments started at sowing; sampled at 7 days after sowing (DAS)
growth_system: NR (soil gravimetric water content 15% control vs 25% high moisture; chamber details NR)
cold_treatments: 4 °C for 5 d from sowing (CS), alone and combined with 25% soil water content (CHS); return to normal conditions at 7 DAS
other_factors: high soil moisture (25%); combined cold + high moisture; tolerant vs sensitive genotype; post-stress recovery
timepoints_duration: 5 d cold from sowing; transcriptome differences reported at 7 DAS; post-recovery sampling times NR
other_omics: metabolome; physiology (alpha-amylase, antioxidants, soluble sugar/protein, ROS, root traits)
key_finding: JD441 recovers better from combined cold and high moisture; amino-acid metabolism genes up in JD441, down in JD558
source_of_details: abstract + web search (full text not accessible)
notes: Abstract only. Abstract says 'transcriptome' without naming sequencing method; RNA-seq presumed but unconfirmed. Cold effect separable from moisture via CS vs control arms.

title: Exogenous 24-Epibrassinolide Improves Low-Temperature Tolerance of Maize Seedlings by Influencing Sugar Signaling and Metabolism
genotypes: Zheng58 (Reid group; female parent of Zhengdan958)
stage_age: 5-d-old etiolated seedlings (grown 5 d at 25 °C in darkness), then treated 5 d
growth_system: illumination incubators; vermiculite pots; sprays applied in darkness
cold_treatments: 10 °C for 5 d (with or without 2.0 µM 24-epibrassinolide spray)
platform_layout: PE150; text states both Illumina NovaSeq (Results) and BGI DNBSEQ-T7 (Methods)
other_omics: glucose, sucrose and starch measurements; qRT-PCR validation
key_finding: 10 °C raises coleoptile sugars; EBR enhances this; sucrose/starch metabolism and photosynthesis DEGs (SPS, SUS) as network nodes
notes: Reads mapped to B73 RefGen_v4 (HISAT2); DESeq2. Data availability statement not seen in retrieved full text. Cold vs 25 °C contrasts with and without EBR (CK vs LT, CKE vs LTE).

title: Tissue-specific chromatin accessibility and transcriptional regulation in maize cold stress response
design_category: NR (cold treatment; temperature not given in abstract)
key_finding: Cold induces tissue-specific DNase I hypersensitive sites linked to DEGs; ERF TFs (ERF5) central regulators
notes: Abstract only; design details and accession must be checked in the full text (ScienceDirect, Data availability). Not the 2020 Han et al. DHS paper on Brachypodium, foxtail millet and sorghum.

title: Integrated Transcriptome and Metabolome Analysis Reveals Mechanism of Flavonoid Synthesis During Low-Temperature Storage of Sweet Corn Kernels
genotypes: Yuetian 28 (sh2 sweet corn hybrid; Crops Research Institute, Guangdong Academy of Agricultural Sciences)
tissue: detached kernels (middle sections of intact kernels from harvested ears)
stage_age: milk stage (about 20 days after pollination), harvested
growth_system: post-harvest storage at about 50% humidity (chamber details NR); not growing plants
platform_layout: Illumina, PE150 (Metware; NEBNext Ultra library prep)
other_omics: widely targeted metabolomics (previous study); POD, PPO, SOD enzyme activities; qRT-PCR
key_finding: Cold storage changes 13,923 genes; 1993 common DEGs; flavonoid biosynthesis affected; ERF TFs EREB14/182/200 candidate regulators
notes: Post-harvest low-temperature storage of detached kernels (not a seedling cold stress). Reads mapped to B73 v5 (HISAT2). Data availability statement not seen in retrieved full text.

title: A Multi-Omics View of Maize's (Zea mays L.) Response to Low Temperatures During the Seedling Stage
growth_system: light incubator (Conviron GEN1000); pots; 25 °C, 12/12 h photoperiod
n_libraries: 12 (computed: 2 genotypes x 2 treatments x 3 reps; text states 12 samples)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 4000 (Nuohe Zhiyuan); read layout NR
other_omics: widely targeted metabolomics (UPLC-MS/MS, Metware); qPCR validation
key_finding: Cold activates flavonoid pathway in tolerant B144; glyoxylate/dicarboxylate metabolism differs between B144 and Q319
notes: Reads mapped to B73 RefGen_v4 (HISAT2); DESeq. Abstract says 'during germination' but methods use 10-d seedlings. Data availability statement not seen in retrieved full text.

title: Benzoxazinoids Biosynthetic Gene Cluster Identification and Expression Analysis in Maize under Biotic and Abiotic Stresses
genotypes: Cold RNA-seq: N192 (chilling-tolerant); Ji853 (chilling-sensitive). Other (non-cold) RNA-seq: Zheng58 (light); F1227 and M0800 (corn borer)
growth_system: growth chamber; plastic boxes; 25 °C, 300 µmol m-2 s-1 white light, 12 h photoperiod; Hoagland solution
cold_treatments: 15 °C for 7 d (with or without 2 µM 24-epibrassinolide spray)
other_factors: 24-epibrassinolide 0 vs 2 µM; tolerant vs sensitive genotype
n_libraries: 24 (cold/EBR RNA-seq: 2 genotypes x 4 treatments x 3 reps)
platform_layout: NR in this paper (same dataset as Zhao2024b, BGI DNBSEQ-T7)
accession: PRJNA1096968 (N192/Ji853 15 vs 25 °C +/- EBR); non-cold sets in same paper: PRJNA917698 (Zheng58 light), PRJNA1121054 (corn borer feeding)
key_finding: Most benzoxazinoid gene-cluster members are down-regulated at 15 °C; DIMBOA falls under low temperature
notes: Same N192/Ji853 RNA-seq dataset as Zhao2024b (identical design); do not count twice. Gene-family/BGC focus. Reads mapped to B73 v4 (HISAT2).

title: Transcriptomic and Physiological Studies Unveil that Brassinolide Maintains the Balance of Maize's Multiple Metabolisms under Low-Temperature Stress
growth_system: growth chamber; vermiculite pots; 12 h light/12 h dark, 70% humidity, 25 °C before treatment; Hoagland solution
cold_treatments: 15 °C for 7 d (with or without 2 µM 24-epibrassinolide spray, 5 mL daily)
other_factors: 24-epibrassinolide 0 vs 2 µM; tolerant vs susceptible genotype
platform_layout: BGI DNBSEQ-T7; read layout NR (about 49 M clean reads per sample)
accession: PRJNA1096968 (stated in Zhao2024a for the identical N192/Ji853 24-sample dataset; not seen in this paper's retrieved text)
other_omics: physiology (ROS, MDA, antioxidant enzymes, IAA/ABA/GA3 by HPLC); WGCNA
key_finding: EBR modulates ROS, hormone and MAPK genes under 15 °C; 332 DEGs; 109 WGCNA hub genes
source_of_details: PMC full text; accession cross-referenced from Zhao2024a
notes: Same RNA-seq dataset as Zhao2024a. Reads mapped to B73 v4 (HISAT2); DESeq2. Accession link to this paper is by design match, not stated in this paper's text.

title: Cold mediates maize root hair developmental plasticity via epidermis-specific transcriptomic responses
genotypes: NR in abstract; mutants rth5 and rth6 (root hair defective); dreb2.1-overexpressing plants
tissue: primary root; root tissues and cell types (epidermis, root hairs)
cold_treatments: moderate cold and cold stress (temperatures NR in abstract)
other_factors: root tissue/cell type; rth5, rth6 mutants; dreb2.1 overexpression
timepoints_duration: NR (dynamic regulation over cold time course implied; root hair recovery)
key_finding: Epidermis shows unique cold response; dreb2.1 down in root hairs and suppresses root hair elongation after moderate cold
notes: Abstract only; check Plant Physiology full text for design and GEO accession. A later paper from the same lab (Sommer, Zhou, Hochholdinger, BMC Genomics 2025; PMC12452017) concerns cold intensities and root hairs; not in this batch.

tissue: seedling true leaves (GWAS trait); RNA-seq tissue NR
other_factors: natural variation in HSF21 promoter (Hap1); bZIP68 binding; lipid metabolism

notes: Abstract mentions 'transcriptome deep sequencing' but not its cold-vs-control design; verify in full text (Molecular Plant) before use.
